title: Bạn có thể giúp tôi theo dõi túi của tôi?
englishTitle: Can you help me track my bag?
pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi theo doi tui cua toi
summary: For asking an airline or baggage-desk staffer to check where your delayed bag is now.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask with the baggage tag, flight number, passport, and any missing-bag report visible.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the tag first, then ask the sentence. Staff may need the barcode or report number more than a long story.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi theo dõi túi của tôi?
phrases.english: Can you help me track my bag?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi theo doi tui cua toi

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; giúp tôi means help me; theo dõi means track; túi của tôi means my bag.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi theo dõi túi của tôi?
breakdown.english: Can you help me track my bag?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Immigration, baggage-claim, and SIM-card cards help if you are still navigating the arrival hall.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good after the belt stops, after filing a report, or when the app says the bag is still in transit.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If they give a status, ask where and when to check again before leaving the baggage area.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Pickup-area, driver-meet, missing-bag, domestic-terminal, and visa cards cover the next airport move.
